prompts.war_shout_darktoon:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE isolated transparent COMBAT VFX sprite for a portrait-based dark fantasy RPG. Original artwork inspired by the forceful expanding barbarian warcry shockwaves of classic Diablo II.
Primary request: a powerful SHOUT detonating outward into a wide irregular rippling shockwave, like compressed air physically bursting out around a warrior. This sprite will be animated from small to huge and displayed at 210-275px over a 90px portrait, allowed to extend FAR OUTSIDE the portrait and card.
Composition: one broad 360-degree irregular EXPANDING RING in slight oblique perspective: elliptical, wide, dynamic, and volumetric. The complete wave front passes across the TOP, SIDES AND BOTTOM, not merely two side brackets. One dominant leading ring, with two incomplete inner wake-arcs and a FEW large outward swept sonic-pressure streaks. Deliberately uneven thickness, interrupted wispy trailing edges, and visible forward motion. Leading front/lower rim is heavier, back/top rim lighter. A naturally hollow transparent center; no opaque disk. Don't force an empty rectangular portrait window. Full composition roughly 85% canvas width with ample transparent padding at all four outer edges so no outer plume is clipped. Square canvas, centered wave at the canvas center.
Mood: low, primal, fierce, a sudden martial BELLOW sending a blast through surrounding air. Windblown pressure and resonant ripples. Dynamic organic contours, not decorative geometry.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background and hollow center; no ground surface, landscape, person, face, body, weapon, horn, banner, text, rune, letters, numbers, logo or watermark. No icon, badge, frame, symmetrically mirrored parentheses, head-mounted shapes, closed necklace, rigid metal hoops, jewelry, shield, sun, flower, perfect smooth geometric circles or static magic circle. No concentric decorative emblems. Do not fill the center with solid light or paint. No random tiny speckles or confetti. Exactly ONE effect, not an atlas, grid, comparison or multiple alternatives.
Rendering: matching a serious dark fantasy CARTOON game, chunky brush-like graphic energy masses with crisp charcoal contour and broad cel-shaded color planes, ivory pressure highlights and one decisive dark shadow. Clean dynamic drawn motion with ragged wind-torn ends. Sparse translucent air at the very trailing tips only; no broad fog backing. Not a flat UI symbol, not photorealistic, not 3D, not glossy plastic, not neon.
